evidence_labels.corpus: doc_id + quote; the quote is checked programmatically to be an exact substring of that document's title or body_text_cn.
evidence_labels.web, not in corpus: A URL found by web search. 'fetched': true means the page was opened and the key sentence read; false means the URL and wording come from a search summary only. Never counted in corpus-verified totals.
evidence_labels.not in corpus: No corpus document and no usable URL; the fact is recalled from general knowledge and is unverified.
evidence_labels.own tally: A count we computed over corpus rows, with the script named.
evidence_labels.officials.db: A row of officials.db (overlaps / career_records); not quote-verified, and the career parser is being repaired.

meta.corpus_verified_rule: A person is corpus-verified when at least one event marked establishes_removal carries corpus evidence whose quote verifies.
coverage_gaps: MAIN GAP. No CCDI site is crawled: 0 documents have a ccdi.gov.cn URL and no site key or name matches it. Every CCDI release in the corpus is a reprint.

Before 2026 the corpus holds almost no contemporaneous announcement of a senior case. For the eleven 副国级+ persons removed in 2012 to 2025 (and 薄熙来), the investigation, expulsion and sentence announcements are absent, except a Guancha relay (郭伯雄 2015), two People's Bank relays (孙政才 2017), one CPPCC chronicle entry (令计划 2015) and two plenum communiques (18-5, 20-3).

Plenum communiques: 18-4, 18-6, 18-7 and every 19th CC plenum with an expulsion paragraph are absent; 20-4 is held only as rows with empty bodies (stic 12454787); 20-2 and 19-7 rows on stic/hrss/mzj also have empty bodies.
The Xinhua tier is a homepage sample (see CLAUDE.md), which is why Xinhua's own releases on these cases are mostly held through stdaily, guancha, qstheory and chinapeace reprints.
苗华 and 杨晶 have no corpus document about their cases at all; 何卫东 has one (a retrospective list by the CCDI secretary).
Name search limits: two-character names (秦刚, 苏荣, 杨晶, 苗华, 张阳) were searched through the segmented index plus title LIKE; namesakes (a Suzhou official 孔苏荣, several 杨晶 and 张阳) were excluded by hand.
